01 / THE APPROACH

The Concept

Across all three days, the agenda is built a few shared work-session blocks. Their intensity and duration vary depending on the day: 15 September is designed around arrivals and settling in, 16 September is the main programme day, and 17 September closes with a final morning session.

Kaspars can present the working format and content in more detail. The Barcelona programme is designed to support those sessions with simple, low-friction city experiences.

16.9Main programme day02

Shared work sessions and a day in Barcelona

The main day combines shared work sessions with a guided Treasure Hunt through Barcelona, which will be our main team-building activity for the day. We’ll then have a second work session before ending the evening with a flamenco show and a team dinner in a traditional Spanish setting.
